fields.statement: Every routine common.psql and tenant.psql create in the rdr and wtr schemas is SECURITY DEFINER with search_path pinned to pg_catalog, pg_temp, PUBLIC holds no EXECUTE right on any of them, and no role but the owner has any right on the orleans schema's tables; orleans_reader may execute only the rdr functions, orleans_writer the rdr functions and wtr procedures, and orleans_client only rdr.orleans_cluster_gateway_list_v1.
fields.scope: The objects and grants installed by ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg's common.psql and tenant.psql.
